title: Recipe and Mixtape
author: Petra Quintana
blurb: Petra Hartwell, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
